summary: Make every Controller slide-over panel drag-resizable from the left edge, with browser-local width persistence and smooth width easing outside of an active drag. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Operators can resize VM and host slide-over panels; the navigate guide documents the gesture and browser-local storage.

api.reason: Controller presentation only; width is localStorage, not a host or Controller API.

roadmap.reason: Console interaction polish; no phase gate moves.

state.reason: Panel width is a per-browser convenience in localStorage (nex.slideover.width), not durable Controller or Core state.

verification.method: npm --prefix web test (ui.test.mjs covers clamp/persist/handle markup); npm --prefix web run typecheck; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. Drag and keyboard resize not exercised in a live browser in this change.
